identityPolicy.rename: Keep id; add previous display term to aliases.
identityPolicy.merge: Explicit redirect plus review/progress migration; never infer from spelling.
identityPolicy.legacy: Retain published ids, including conflicting source archive headings, for review.
identityPolicy.dimensions: Difficulty, skill, grade, format and question type are independent of topic.

relations.PRIMARY: Direct topic measured or explained; multiple allowed.
relations.PREREQUISITE: Needed prior knowledge, not a claim of direct coverage.

identityPolicy.parentInheritance: Query expansion only; counts use distinct itemKey.
identityPolicy.scope: CANDIDATE is separate from CONFIRMED; no silent promotion.

legacySources.archiveIds: Retained; not merged based on a similar title.
